---
title: "Daily Analytics Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: darkly
    highlight: tango
params:
  run_date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(DBI)
library(odbc)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

# CI's "dry run" step supplies placeholder (dummy_*) Snowflake credentials --
# there is no live account to connect to in that context. USE_LIVE_DB detects
# that and switches the data chunks below to synthetic sample data instead,
# so this Rmd can genuinely render standalone (structure, plots, tables) as
# a real dry run. With real credentials (production runs), it queries
# Snowflake as before.
USE_LIVE_DB <- Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT") != "" &&
  Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT") != "dummy_account"

if (USE_LIVE_DB) {
  con <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),
    Driver    = "Snowflake",
    Server    = paste0(Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT"), ".snowflakecomputing.com"),
    UID       = Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_USER"),
    PWD       = Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD"),
    Database  = Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE", "ANALYTICS"),
    Schema    = Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA", "PROD"),
    Warehouse = Sys.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE", "COMPUTE_WH")
  )
} else {
  con <- NULL
  message("No live Snowflake credentials -- rendering with sample data (dry run).")
}
```

## Executive Summary

Report generated for: **`r params$run_date`**

```{r summary}
if (USE_LIVE_DB) {
  summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
    SELECT
      SUM(total_events) as total_events,
      SUM(unique_users) as unique_users,
      SUM(revenue) as total_revenue,
      AVG(conversion_rate) as avg_conversion
    FROM PROD.FCT_HOURLY_METRICS
    WHERE event_date = '%s'
  ", params$run_date))
} else {
  summary <- data.frame(
    total_events   = 128432,
    unique_users   = 15234,
    total_revenue  = 48213.55,
    avg_conversion = 0.0327
  )
}

summary %>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Total Events", "Unique Users", "Revenue", "Avg Conversion")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Hourly Breakdown

```{r hourly_plot}
if (USE_LIVE_DB) {
  hourly <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
    SELECT * FROM PROD.FCT_HOURLY_METRICS
    WHERE event_date = '%s'
    ORDER BY event_hour
  ", params$run_date))
} else {
  set.seed(42)
  hourly <- data.frame(
    event_hour = 0:23,
    revenue    = round(runif(24, min = 500, max = 4000), 2)
  )
}

ggplot(hourly, aes(x = event_hour, y = revenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#00d2ff") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(title = "Hourly Revenue", x = "Hour", y = "Revenue") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Top Performing Segments

```{r segments}
if (USE_LIVE_DB) {
  segments <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT user_segment, COUNT(*) as users, AVG(lifetime_value) as avg_ltv
    FROM PROD.DIM_USERS
    GROUP BY user_segment
  ")
} else {
  segments <- data.frame(
    user_segment = c("New", "Returning", "VIP", "At Risk"),
    users        = c(6120, 5890, 1340, 1884),
    avg_ltv      = c(24.10, 87.45, 412.30, 55.60)
  )
}

segments %>% kbl() %>% kable_styling()
```

```{r cleanup}
if (USE_LIVE_DB && DBI::dbIsValid(con)) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
}
```
